apps.localizedDescription: YouPro mod of YouTube for iOS. Includes no ads, background playback, downloads, iSponsorBlock, PiP, and a host of customizable tweaks.

versions.localizedDescription:
### Latest Release, ENJOY!!
> [!NOTE]
> - **YTUHD** is not included. 4K60HDR is available.
> - if you're signed out you can sign in manually. 
> - no iSponsorBlock. (unstable in newer builds)
> - for <A15 devices press share button in the arrow down panel and use external player for AV1 videos.
> - downloads are unstable for <A15 devices. some will fail due to no av1 codec. 
> - - -
> #### Extra Tweaks:
> - `YouPip` `YouSlider` `YTweaks` `YouSpeed` `YouMute` `YouLoop` `YTABConfig` `YouQuality` `YouChooseQuality`  `YouGetCaption` 
> -  `Return-YouTube-Dislikes` `DontEatMyContent` `Open in YouTube (Safari Extension)` `Gonerino` 

> [!WARNING]
> - 21.34.3+ builds require iOS 17+ now.
